newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -June 17.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -June 17.

text.p: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST
-------------- June 17, 1997 ------------ News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet, Brand-name Products and People News.
ADVERTISING & MARKETING:

PARIS - French advertising group Publicis can make up for lost time and set up its own worldwide network now its divorce with U.S. True North has been finalised, analysts and industry experts say. (Reuter)

PARIS - Publicis and French television presenter Christophe Dechavanne's production company Coyote Conseil form a joint venture to make programmes financed by one or more advertisers and sell them to television channels. (Le Figaro)
PARIS - Havas Communication wins the advertising concession for the new Hong Kong airport for five years from October 1998. (Le Figaro)
MEDIA & THE INTERNET

PARIS - French telephone operator France Telecom has meetings with Internet service providers but these are not commercial talks or negotiations at the moment, a France Telecom spokesman says. Financial daily Les Echos said Lagardere Groupe was seeking closer ties between its Club Internet unit and France Telecom's Internet service provider Wanadoo. (Reuter)
PARIS - Pierre Bellanger, founder of French youth music radio station Skyrock, says public radio stations are hogging frequencies for themselves. (La Tribune)
BRAND-NAME PRODUCTS & MARKETS:

BORDEAUX - Prices of 1996 wines surge. Wines sold two years ahead are selling for between 20 percent and 120 percent more before tax this year, salesmen say. Some top names like Chateau Margaux are absent from catalogues after big Asian or American buyers snapped up the lot, and some previously affordable wines now cost more than a 1992 Chateau Margaux. (Le Parisien)

ABIDJAN - French chocolate confectioners plan to hold their 1998 Festival International du Chocolat trade fair in Ivory Coast and open up participation to more countries, the festival's president says. (Reuter)

NORTHFIELD, Ill.- Kraft Foods Inc, a unit of Philip Morris Cos Inc, says it reaches agreement to sell its Anco Foods distribution company to Schratter Foods, a unit of French specialty cheese maker Bongrain Group. (Reuter)
PEOPLE NEWS:
PARIS - Serge Adda is appointed chairman of Canal Plus Horizons following the resignation of Catherine Tasca, who was elected to Parliament in the recent French elections. (Reuter)
PARIS - Jean-Marcel Bougereau has been appointed editor of weekly news magazine Le Nouvel Oservateur. He is currently editorial writer for daily newspaper La Republique des Pyrenees.
(Le Figaro)
Paris Editorial, Sue Landau
